subject: Post-demo: Privacy & DPA pathing for CarePlus Analytics
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@careplusanalytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Privacy & DPA pathing for CarePlus Analytics

Tom — thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the privacy/compliance front: 

Summary from call:
- CarePlus good to proceed on technical fit; key gating items are DPA language, SCC module selection for EU traffic, and a short SOC 2 status confirmation.
- You mentioned procurement wants a DPA + SCC path and will issue the vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) shortly.

Action items I propose (with owners):
1) Share Redwood DPA template + proposed SCC module options (Rishi) — I can send a redlined DPA and recommend module mapping based on your controller/processor roles.
2) Security evidence snapshot (Ben) — short note on SOC 2 status, encryption at rest/in transit, and data retention defaults.
3) VSQ kickoff (Monica) — we'll start answering the standard spreadsheet and flag any items needing legal input.
4) Procurement timeline & any contract redline deadlines (Tom / Procurement) — if you can share target sign date we can prioritize.

Clarifying question from our side: on GDPR role mapping — you mentioned CarePlus will act as controller for customer data but may process downstream datasets for analytics. Can you confirm whether CarePlus expects Redwood to be processor for the feature set we demoed (inference + embeddings) or if there are any controller-to-controller data flows we should plan for? That will determine the SCC module we recommend.

Next step: I will attach a short note describing SCC module options and flag which one we typically recommend for similar telemetry/usage patterns. Ben will follow up with SOC 2 details. Monica will send the VSQ response template and a first-pass.

If that sounds right, I'll send the DPA + SCC note by EOD Pacific.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com | +1 415 555 0123

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_Template_v1.2.pdf (sent), SCC_Module_Options_onepager.pdf (sent)

From: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@careplusanalytics.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@careplusanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Privacy & DPA pathing for CarePlus Analytics

Thanks Rishi — helpful summary. A few answers from our side: 

- Timeline: procurement is aiming for an internal sign target of 2027-10-15. They asked for DPA + SCC mapping as part of initial packet.
- Role mapping: CarePlus is controller for customer PII (ingest + storage). For the inference outputs and derived embeddings, we typically act as controller for our analytics customers, but we do send raw customer snippets to inference providers for feature generation — so in practice Redwood will be a processor for those calls.
- SOC 2: we need a short statement that Redwood is SOC 2 Type II audited or in-progress. If in-progress, provide expected completion and interim controls.

I'm attaching our DPA request form and the procurement VSQ to speed review. Laura/Ben/Monica — feel free to route any questions back to me or procurement.

Tom
Head of Procurement | CarePlus Analytics
Tom.Bennett@careplusanalytics.com | +1 617 555 0199

Attachments: CarePlus_DPA_Request_20270910.pdf, CarePlus_VSQ_Response_20270910.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@careplusanalytics.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Privacy & DPA pathing for CarePlus Analytics

Tom / team — quick security snapshot as requested: 

SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II for our core inference platform (audit period ended 2026-11-30). We maintain an up-to-date SOC 2 report for customers on request under an NDA; if you want the full report we can arrange NDA & secure transfer.

Interim controls / highlights:
- Encryption: TLS 1.2+ in transit; AES-256 at rest for customer data at rest in our hosted environment.
- Access control: RBAC + SCIM provisioning for enterprise customers; audit logs retained per account-level setting (default 90 days).
- Data handling: request-level caching is opt-in per account; by default we do not persist raw customer payloads beyond request processing unless customer enables logging for debugging.
- Pen tests: annual third-party penetration tests; highest severity items addressed within SLA timelines.

I'll pair this with the DPA template Rishi sends and mark any security-specific clauses that need lift from procurement VSQ.

Ben Carter
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@careplusanalytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Privacy & DPA pathing for CarePlus Analytics

Great — thanks for the clarifications, Tom. Next steps from our side: 

1) I'll post the redlined Redwood DPA and a short SCC mapping note to the Drive link shared (or send directly to procurement if you prefer DocuSign). Expect that within 2 business days. Recommended mapping: controller-to-processor flow (we'll include language that covers controller-to-controller downstream data sharing if needed).
2) Ben has provided the SOC 2/high-level controls — we'll prepare the SOC 2 transfer path (NDA & secure link) if procurement wants the full report.
3) Monica will start the VSQ and post an initial answers workbook to your procurement inbox; we'll flag any items that require legal resolution.

If procurement has any must-have redline items (e.g., data deletion windows, subprocessor lists, incident SLA terms) please send them to me or Laura (legal) so we can triage.

I'll follow up with the DPA + SCC note EOB Monday.

Thanks again — looking forward to keeping this moving.

Rishi
